faq.question: Can I ask about my pet care booking?
faq.answer: Yes. Our team can help you with booking details, appointment changes, and service information.

faq.question: Can I contact Pawmie about grooming?
faq.answer: Of course. You can ask about grooming packages, available time slots, and the best care option for your pet.

faq.question: Can I ask general pet care questions?
faq.answer: Yes. You can contact us for friendly guidance about pet care services, visits, and support.
